Questions homeowners ask

Roofing service FAQ

What services does Country Roofing & Construction LLC offer?

Country Roofing & Construction LLC provides residential roofing, commercial roofing, roof repair, storm damage repair, roof replacement, siding, gutters, and home renovation support.

Where does Country Roofing & Construction LLC provide roofing services?

Country Roofing & Construction LLC is based in Kalamazoo, MI and serves Kalamazoo County, Barry County, Allegan County, Van Buren County, and surrounding Southwest Michigan areas.

Do you offer roof repairs or only full roof replacements?

We handle both roof repairs and full roof replacements. After looking at the roof, we can explain whether a repair makes sense or whether replacement is the better long-term option.

Can you help with storm damage?

Yes. We help with roof damage caused by wind, hail, heavy rain, missing shingles, and other storm-related issues. We can also provide guidance if an insurance claim may be involved.

What roofing materials do you work with?

We work with asphalt shingles, metal roofing, tile roofing, siding, and gutters. Our team can help you choose materials based on budget, style, and performance needs.

Is Country Roofing & Construction LLC licensed and insured?

Yes. Country Roofing & Construction LLC is licensed and insured to provide roofing and construction services in Southwest Michigan.

Do you provide free estimates?

Yes. Country Roofing & Construction LLC provides free estimates. You can request an estimate online or call (269) 303-3604.

How long does a roofing project take?

The timeline depends on the size of the roof, the type of work, materials, and weather. Smaller repairs may be completed quickly, while full roof replacements require more planning and coordination.

How can I schedule a consultation?

You can request an estimate online or call Country Roofing & Construction LLC at (269) 303-3604 to discuss your roofing or exterior project.
